en.sayed-ali-raza: Divide the property into two parts
and let the owner choose one. When he has chosen do not object to it.
Then divide the remaining into two parts
and let him choose one and when he has chosen do not raise any objection.
Continue like this till only that much remains which is enough to satisfy Allāh’s dues.
Then take Allāh’s due from it.
If he disputes your action allow his views,
and repeat what you had done before
till you take Allāh’s due from his property.
